topic: What would happen if the Earth was twice its size?

scenario.title: What if Earth Was TWICE its Size?
scenario.clickbait_title: EARTH DOUBLES IN SIZE: You Have SECONDS To Live.
scenario.thumbnail_concept: A terrified person on cracked ground, struggling against immense pressure. Buildings lean precariously in the background. Dramatic, dark, vertical composition. High contrast.
scenario.seo_description: What if Earth suddenly doubled its size? Your bones would crack, buildings would collapse, and the air would suffocate you. Explore the terrifying science behind a planet twice as big. Can humanity survive?

scenes.narration: Your bones CRACK. The world's gravity just doubled. You weigh twice as much. Every muscle strains. Buildings groan, buckling under their own impossible weight. Can anything stand?
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL composition. A person struggling on cracked, buckled pavement, barely able to stand, looking up in terror. Skyscrapers in the background are visibly bending and collapsing, dust plumes rising. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic, wide-angle lens showing immense scale of destruction.
scenes.twist_element: The sudden, visceral feeling of doubled gravity and immediate structural collapse, leaving a question of survival.

scenes.narration: But it gets worse. Roli, the time-traveling rabbit, warns the air itself turns toxic. Its density doubles, suffocating you slowly. The crust groans, tectonic plates rupture. Earthquakes become constant. What truly kills you first?
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL composition. Roli, the steampunk-outfitted rabbit scientist, stands amidst the ruins of a city, looking concerned at a dense, hazy, oppressive sky. The ground around him is severely fractured with visible seismic activity. Distant volcanoes are erupting. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic.
scenes.twist_element: The atmosphere itself becoming a threat, and the escalating geological instability, raising the question of the ultimate cause of death.

scenes.narration: Roli reveals the true horror: a planet doubling in size means its internal heat and pressure skyrocket. The Earth violently expands, ripping itself apart. Molten rock spews globally, boiling oceans into steam. Your bones CRACK.
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL composition. An apocalyptic global view of Earth from space. The planet is visibly tearing apart, molten lava streams across continents, and vast plumes of steam erupt from boiling oceans. The atmosphere is choked with ash. Ultra-realistic, catastrophic scale, dramatic lighting.
scenes.twist_element: The ultimate twist: the planet's own violent internal instability is the greatest threat, not just surface gravity or atmosphere. The ending seamlessly loops back to the opening line.
